response.text: Note that 5900 is unused. Let me check the balance (with proper quoting), then the invoice-to-ledger tie-out.

arguments.sql: select j."JRNL_NO", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" j join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=j."JRNL_NO" group by j."JRNL_NO" having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", i."STAT_CD", (select sum(l."CR_AMT")-sum(l."DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') ap_net, (select count(*) from "GLJRNH" h where h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") hc from "APINVH" i where (select coalesce(sum(l."CR_AMT")-sum(l."DR_AMT"),0) from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') <> i."INV_AMT"

select lower(regexp_replace(ltrim(trim(v."VEND_CD"),'0'),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) vk, regexp_replace(lower(trim(i."INV_NO")),'[^a-z0-9]','','g') nk, count(*), array_agg(i."INV_ID"), array_agg(i."INV_AMT") from "APINVH" i join "APVEND" v on v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD" group by 1,2 having count(*)>1
